decision: Widen the section-register and section-content-wrap conventions so each also covers the site footer: register selects the footer's material treatment and wrap supplies its centered content wrapper. Both amendments change meaning and whenToUse only.

evidence.channel: Owner answers forwarded in odd/tasks/round-5-consumer-requests.md (L3 and L5), 2026-11-26

userStatements.provenance: odd/tasks/round-5-consumer-requests.md L5 (specs, Footer v0.4 OQ-1 convention scope)

evidence.interpretation: Scoped convention approval only: it binds the exact amended text below, which the approved Footer v0.4 spec quotes in the section 3 table (OQ-1), and is not native review authority. L3 names section-register; the L5 spec answer took the recommended resolution of OQ-1, which extends the same widening to section-content-wrap. The owner approved the committed spec draft with its recommended answers, so the spec digest binds the resulting bytes, not a digest the owner quoted. The implementation plan that creates this receipt was approved in L6. The receipt does not approve the Footer implementation, a visual capture, an exception, an alias or any other convention.

before.meaning: The combined visual register selected for a section frame; values and recipes are component-specific.
before.whenToUse: Select a section's coordinated scene and material treatment.

after.meaning: The combined visual register selected for a section frame or for the site footer; values and recipes are component-specific.
after.whenToUse: Select a section's coordinated scene and material treatment, or the site footer's material treatment.

semanticAmendments.boundary: SectionShell and Footer only; values, defaults and recipes stay component-specific; no new convention, name, exception, component, token or dependency; no automatic API migration.

before.meaning: Whether a section frame supplies its own centered content wrapper.
before.whenToUse: Choose whether section children receive the section content max-width and gutters.

after.meaning: Whether a section frame or the site footer supplies its own centered content wrapper.
after.whenToUse: Choose whether section or footer children receive the page content max-width and gutters.

semanticAmendments.boundary: SectionShell and Footer only; values, defaults and recipes stay component-specific; no new convention, name, exception, component, token or dependency; no automatic API migration.

convention.name: register
convention.meaning: The combined visual register selected for a section frame or for the site footer; values and recipes are component-specific.
convention.whenToUse: Select a section's coordinated scene and material treatment, or the site footer's material treatment.
convention.avoid: Do not use for a color tone alone, a generic visual variant or choreography.

convention.name: wrap
convention.meaning: Whether a section frame or the site footer supplies its own centered content wrapper.
convention.whenToUse: Choose whether section or footer children receive the page content max-width and gutters.
convention.avoid: Do not use for flex wrapping, a gap, padding alone or a portal container.
